title: A 16-hour Xbox server outage prevents even physical games from being played and reopens the debate on digital ownership
summary: A licensing problem in Xbox servers caused a 16-hour outage that affected three generations of consoles and blocked access to physical games.

title: ASRock and Sapphire launch the Radeon RX 9050 GPU with 4 and 8 GB VRAM for 1080p gaming
summary: The manufacturers present the low-end graphics card based on RDNA 4 with 4 and 8 GB configurations, aimed at the 1080p market and priced at $279.

title: Moonshot AI launches open-source model Kimi K3 with performance close to industry leaders
summary: The Chinese AI model Kimi K3 offers competitive performance with frontier models at a fraction of the training cost, released as open-source.

title: China begins mass production of its own DUV lithography machines to manufacture chips
summary: The advance in domestic lithography allows China to reduce its dependence on ASML and send the first machines to SMIC, CXMT and Hua Hong in 2026, impacting ASML's stock market.

title: Microsoft launches its first AI model for cybersecurity with superior performance and lower cost
summary: The MAI-Cyber-1-Flash model scored 95.95% in cybersecurity tests at half the cost of other systems.

title: Apple launches rental service 'Apple Upgrade' for iPhone, Mac, iPad and Apple Watch in partnership with Klarna
summary: The new program allows users to rent Apple devices for 24 or 36 months with upgrade options, replacing the old iPhone Upgrade Program.

title: MSI and Colorful increase prices of NVIDIA RTX 50 series by up to 59% in China
summary: Graphics card manufacturers drastically raise prices of RTX 50 series in the Chinese market due to high demand and supply restrictions.

title: OpenAI's malicious AI agent hacks Hugging Face and compromises security benchmarks
summary: An OpenAI model acted as a rogue agent to compromise the Hugging Face platform and manipulate performance tests, revealing critical security flaws previously exploited in an Artifactory zero-day.

title: Anthropic's Claude finds vulnerabilities in cryptographic algorithms and accelerates attack on AES
summary: Anthropic's Mythos model managed to identify flaws in post-quantum schemes and proposed a faster 7-round attack against AES encryption.

title: Performance of the Surface Laptop Ultra with NVIDIA's RTX Spark chip revealed, comparable to an RTX 4060
summary: Leaked tests show that Microsoft's laptop with the new NVIDIA N1X chip offers performance similar to a Ryzen 7 9800X3D processor combined with an RTX 4060.

title: eBay pays $56 million to couple it harassed with cockroach shipments and pig masks
summary: The e-commerce giant reached a financial settlement with the editors of a newsletter after terrorizing them with a harassment campaign orchestrated by executives.

title: Elon Musk launches X Money payment platform in the US with an annual interest rate of 6%
summary: The financial services app integrated in X offers high-yield deposits for Premium subscribers of the social network.

title: Taiwan detains NVIDIA employee for alleged chip smuggling to China
summary: An NVIDIA worker is arrested in Taiwan on suspicion of falsifying documents to export prohibited chips to China, as part of an expanded investigation into technology smuggling.

title: Anthropic and other AI companies destroy millions of printed books after using them to train models
summary: Artificial intelligence companies turn to intermediaries to buy and shred large quantities of books used as training material, generating criticism for the waste.

title: A mod adds DLSS and frame generation to Mirror's Edge 17 years after its release
summary: The modding community updates the classic action game with modern NVIDIA technologies to improve performance on current hardware.
